[LSER.10.17] **Unique-required schema scoping.** An unqualified
`series <slot>` binds to the unique schema in scope with a
slot of that name. Zero matches and 2+ matches are compile
errors; the author qualifies as `<SchemaName>.<slot>` to
disambiguate. Adding a new schema with a same-named slot
makes the previously-unambiguous declaration ambiguous and
fails the build at the declaration site, not silently
elsewhere.
Restates [LSER.7.7].
